Sure! If you’re looking to see the current time directly from the Command Prompt on Windows, there’s an easy built‑in way:

```cmd
C:\> time /T
```

or simply echo the environment variable:

```cmd
C:\> echo %TIME%
```

Both will print something like:

```
10:45 PM
```

If you’d prefer to capture this value into a batch script or pass it along to another program, you can store it in a variable first:

```cmd
@echo off
set CURRENT_TIME=%TIME%
rem Now you can use !CURRENT_TIME! wherever you need it (enable delayed expansion)
```

Let me know if you need help formatting the timestamp differently or integrating it into a larger automation workflow!
